title: The AI Incident Disclosure Shadow: incident-to-filing dataset, coding logs, and analysis code (2019-2026)
description: Annotated dataset and reproducible pipeline matching AIID-recorded AI incidents to U.S.-listed issuers' SEC filings, with a four-tier disclosure taxonomy (T1-T4), coding logs, independent double-coding, hashed pre-registration, and analysis scripts. Measures disclosure behavior, not compliance.
notes: AIID-derived incident records are subject to the AI Incident Database's CC BY-SA 4.0 terms. Original analysis code is separately licensed under MIT. SEC EDGAR filing texts are public-domain materials. The study measures disclosure in a defined filing universe, not legal compliance.
